primary_source.citation: Chen J, et al. Distant metastasis patterns among lung cancer subtypes and impact of primary tumor resection on survival in metastatic lung cancer using SEER database. Sci Rep. 2024.

biomarkers.name: Chromogranin A, synaptophysin, INSM1
biomarkers.prevalence: Usually positive in at least one neuroendocrine marker; synaptophysin and INSM1 are commonly positive, chromogranin A is variable

biomarkers.name: Ki-67
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma and helps distinguish from atypical carcinoid

biomarkers.name: TP53, RB1
biomarkers.prevalence: Co-alteration enriched in the SCLC-like molecular subset; reported in a substantial subset of LCNEC but not universal
biomarkers.clinical_use: Molecular subtyping: SCLC-like (TP53+RB1 co-alteration/loss) may benefit from platinum-etoposide (SCLC-like regimen); NSCLC-like tumors more often harbor NSCLC-type alterations and may be treated with NSCLC regimens

biomarkers.name: KRAS, STK11, KEAP1
biomarkers.prevalence: Enriched in the NSCLC-like molecular subset

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Large cells with neuroendocrine architecture (nests, palisading, rosettes) and NE marker positivity by IHC
histomorphological_subtype.grading: High-grade by definition; Ki-67 usually high and often >40%, mitoses >10/2 mm�b2, necrosis common

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells (PNEC) are a plausible cell of origin for at least a subset; molecular studies support biologic heterogeneity with more than one evolutionary route
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm  foregut-derived pulmonary epithelium with neuroendocrine differentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: High-grade neuroendocrine  synaptophysin and/or chromogranin/INSM1 positive, but with larger cells and more cytoplasm than SCLC, often with nucleolar prominence
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Molecular studies reveal two distinct subgroups: SCLC-like (TP53+RB1 co-alteration/loss) and NSCLC-like (STK11, KEAP1, KRAS)  reflecting convergence from different lineage backgrounds toward similar morphology
